newsitem.title: UK: BT hit by profit-taking after strong gains.
newsitem.headline: BT hit by profit-taking after strong gains.

text.p: Shares in British Telecommunications Plc fell two and a half percent on Monday after a dramatic twelve percent climb last week.
The shares were down 13-1/2p at 488p by 1435 GMT in trade of over 14 million shares.
"It's a correction that's slightly overdue after the big rise last week," commented one market-maker.
"The shares have had a really racy time over the last few days," said another.
Last week BT stock climbed 55p to a closing high of 501p and earlier on Monday the shares reached an intraday record of 504-1/2p before profit-taking set in.
